Create an entirely NEW illustration; do not edit, recreate or include the reference's humanoid character, clothing or scene.
Primary request: a ferocious, imposing, mature epic dragon creature in dramatic action, substantially more powerful and dangerous than a gentle storybook creature. Keep richly colorful sophisticated adventure-book art, with narrow predatory eyes, formidable horns, sharp teeth and armored scales. No cute, baby, friendly, chibi or cartoon mascot proportions.
Composition/framing: horizontal landscape 5:3, one complete creature with an unmistakable readable central silhouette. Its head, tail, all defining limbs and both wings if applicable fit comfortably inside the frame with breathing room for a shallow card crop. Three-quarter side view where it clarifies the anatomy. Full-bleed painted landscape, no border or panels.

Constraints: strict anatomy specified below; a single creature only. No people, extra creatures, franchise characters, typography, captions, signatures, logos, watermarks, interface, collage or gore. Keep the creature visually separated from its epic background; environmental effects must not obscure its anatomy.

Full body, extended wings, fierce adult proportions, commanding force and dramatic motion.
